# Private static reifiable results

Independently authored methods call private static generic helpers only within
their declaring class. An unbounded token, a callback and a wide scalar do not
determine the result-only Object formal. A second helper forwards an existing
varargs array without changing its identity or element-read failure timing.

The frozen observer checks eight routes and eighteen scenarios twice in fresh
JVMs, including nulls, independent result types, late result casts, callback
mutation, exact exceptions, array stores and wide values. Incorrect programs
must fail the same observer. Signature-only controls preserve original Code and
descriptors while changing the proof obligations. The dependency profile moves
the callback interface and state carrier into a JAR; private helpers stay with
their original callers. All recovered Java is compiled and checked for original
class/method definitions, roles, access, signatures and exception declarations.
